spans.s: स्खद् vt. 1Ā (pres. स्खदते) 1. To cut, to tear to pieces; 2. to destroy; 3. to hurt, to injure, to kill; 4. to rout, to defeat; 5. to harass, to fatigue.
स्खदन n. 1. Cutting; 2. hurting, injuring, killing; 3. harassing.
स्खल् vi. 1P (pres. स्खलति) 1. To stumble, to fall down, to slip, to trip, स्खलंती स्वर्लोकादवनितलशोकापहृतये G.

, K.S.v.25; 2. to totter, to waver; 3. to fall or deviate from the right course; 4. to make mistakes, to blunder, to err, स्मरसि स्मर मेखलागुणैरुत गोत्रस्खलितेषु बंधनम् K.S.iv.8; 5. to stammer, to falter, to lisp, वदनकमलकं शिशोः स्मरामि स्खलदसमंजसमंजुजल्पितं ते Ut.iv., K.S.v.56; 6. to drop, to drip, to trickle; 7. to go, to move; 8. to disappear; 9. to gather, to collect.With प्र-, to jolt, to jostle, रथ्याः प्रचस्खलुः साश्वाः Bt.xiv.94.

स्खल् Caus. (स्खलयति-ते) 1. to cause to stumble, to trip up; 2. to cause to make mistakes, to cause to blunder, to fail, skhalayati vacanaM te saMSrayatyaMgamaMgam M.M.iii., वचनानि स्खलनम् पदे पदे K.S.iv.12.

स्खलन n. 1. The act of stumbling, slipping, tripping; 2. falling or deviating from the right course; 3. blundering, error, mistake; 4. blundering in speech or pronunciation, faltering; 5. dropping, dripping; 6. dashing, clashing; 7. mutual striking or rubbing together.

स्खलित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Stumbled, slipped; 2. dropped down; 3. shaking, fluctuating, hesitating; 4. intoxicated, drunk; 5. agitated, disturbed; 6. dropped, effused, emitted; 7. trickling down; 8. interrupted, stopped; 9. confounded; 10. gone.
स्खलित (II) n. 1. Tumbling, falling; 2. deviation from the right course; 3. blunder, fault, error, sin; 4. deceit, treachery; 5. circumvention, strategem (in war).

स्खलित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Stumbled, slipped; 2. dropped down; 3. shaking, fluctuating, hesitating; 4. intoxicated, drunk; 5. agitated, disturbed; 6. dropped, effused, emitted; 7. trickling down; 8. interrupted, stopped; 9. confounded; 10. gone.
स्खलित-सुभगम् ind. dashing or flowing along in a charming manner (said of a stream), संसर्पंत्याः स्खलित सुभगं दर्शितावर्तनाभेः Megh.i.28.
